activities.description: Narrator discusses the upcoming solar eclipse and shows a picture of Comet 12P/Pons-Brooks from Spaceweather.com.
Narrator explains the comet’s recent outburst and references a previous outburst of Comet Holmes.
Narrator shows a picture of Comet Holmes from 2007 and discusses its massive outburst.
Narrator returns to the topic of Comet 12P/Pons-Brooks and shares details about its tail and coma size.
Narrator shares a personal anecdote about accidentally deleting a 22-minute video he was working on.
Narrator reads verses from Matthew chapter 5 in the Bible.

characterInteraction.description: The narrator is the only character present. He addresses the audience directly, fostering a sense of connection and shared interest.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The narrator's reading of biblical verses following the anecdote about his deleted video creates a subtle link between technological setbacks and spiritual guidance.

Return to the topic of Comet 12P/Pons-Brooks and its current size.
Personal anecdote about the deleted video.
Transition to reading biblical verses.

activities.description: Narrator shows an image of Comet 12P/Pons-Brooks captured by an amateur astronomer from France.
Narrator displays a second image of the comet captured by an amateur astronomer.

Narrator plays a short video showing the comet from the STEREO HI1 spacecraft.
Narrator points out an unknown object in the STEREO HI1 video and suggests it might be a CME.
Narrator continues scrolling through images of the comet taken by various amateur astronomers.
Narrator encourages viewers to join a Facebook group dedicated to comet observations.

characterInteraction.description: The narrator maintains his direct address to the audience, inviting them to share his enthusiasm and wonder at the comet's activity and the collaborative efforts of amateur astronomers.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The interconnectedness of space and its phenomena, as the narrator draws connections between the comet’s outburst and possible CMEs captured by the STEREO spacecraft.

Continued showcasing of amateur images, highlighting the comet’s changing appearance.

Identification of an unknown object in the STEREO footage, sparking curiosity about its nature and origin.
Return to amateur images, reinforcing the active community engaged in comet observation.
Encouragement for viewers to participate in comet observation and share their findings, fostering a sense of community engagement.

videoEditingDetails.description: The scene consists of a YouTube video playing in the background while the narrator summarizes its content. Possible trims include ending the scene shortly after the narrator finishes reading the transcript.

activities.description: Narrator briefly mentions another YouTube video about the comet and its connection to the "Devil's Comet."
Narrator switches to scrolling through Twitter, highlighting current events that he finds disturbing.
Narrator shows an image depicting the comet's position relative to the sun and planets during the eclipse.
Narrator points out the presence of Comet Inky 2P in the image.
Narrator discusses the theory that a fragment from a larger comet that broke apart 12,000 years ago caused a mass extinction event.
Narrator returns to the importance of noting Comet Inky 2P in the eclipse image.

characterInteraction.description: The narrator continues to address the audience directly, but his tone shifts from excitement to concern, fostering a sense of shared unease.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The juxtaposing of the "Devil's Comet" with disturbing current events creates a sense of foreboding and suggests a link between the comet's appearance and an increase in negativity or chaos.

The narrator's tone becomes more inquisitive.

Transition to showcasing disturbing current events, creating a sense of unease and foreshadowing potential chaos.
Return to the eclipse alignment image, highlighting the comet's position relative to other celestial bodies.
Mention of Comet Inky 2P, further emphasizing the significance of comets in this alignment.
Introduction of a historical connection between a fragmented comet and a mass extinction event, amplifying the sense of unease and potential danger.
Final emphasis on the presence of Comet Inky 2P in the eclipse image, suggesting a potential cosmic link between these events.
